Can a methuselah contest his own cards with a duplicate?

ie: two hunting grounds of the same type (to burn a card)

Im guessing he can, paying the pool, and burning one at any time as
usual?

T

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Talo...@hotmail.com writes:

> Can a methuselah contest his own cards with a duplicate?

Yes.

> ie: two hunting grounds of the same type (to burn a card)
>
> Im guessing he can, paying the pool,

Yes.

> and burning one at any time as
> usual?

Incorrect. You can only burn a card to avoid contesting it during
your untap phase. This occurs *after* uncontested cards which were
previously contested have been returned to you (also during the untap
phase), so contesting and burning creates a turn of lag.
